summary: Project involves building/deploying an app that uses an 18-hole chart/grid of values provided by the user; current focus is recovering from a deployment failure and rebuilding with a clean 18-hole grid.
architectural_notes: App build process should accept an 18-hole grid input (rows keyed by hole number with numeric values, including decimals) as configuration/data for the build.
known_issues: Deployment/build failed during last publish; system recovery/retry needed.

existing_features.title: Update the shipped 18-hole Callaway grid defaults to match the user-provided 13-row table (row number followed by five (grossScore, worstHoles) pairs). Store these values in frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartPersistence.ts within getDefault18GridChart() so a fresh install (no localStorage) uses the new grid.

Ensure existing localStorage migration/reset behavior correctly picks up the new shipped 18-hole defaults for users who still have older shipped defaults cached in localStorage (i.e., remove old shipped defaults so the updated shipped defaults are used when appropriate).

new_feature_requests.summary: Support entering/ingesting a clean 18-hole grid (chart values) provided by the user for rebuilding the app
Align backend Callaway chart logic with the updated 18-hole chart behavior so backend calculations (backend/main.mo) are consistent with the 18-hole grid defaults used by the frontend for scoring.
Use English for all user-facing UI strings involved in chart editing, validation, save/reset messaging, and any new messaging introduced by these changes.
